activity.notes: Representative c.1128 intellectual/religious activity point, not an assertion that a single Rāmānuja event is exactly dated to 1128. Epigraphic review records a Tonnur inscription granting to a maṭha of Rāmānuja and another inscriptional reference tied to his pre-sannyāsa name, treating these as confirmation of the traditional Tonnur visit. A separate 1128 record places Hoysala king Vishnuvardhana ruling at Yādavapura/Tonnur. ATLAS therefore joins the person-place evidence to the same Hoysala political setting at likely confidence and records active_in rather than royal service. Rāmānuja's absolute lifespan dates remain debated.
